land.heroSub: The shared shopping list for everyday life — coordinate with family and friends, discover recipes and never forget a thing.
land.featuresSub: One app with it all — from the first item to the shared shop.
land.f1d: Multiple lists, live sync with family and friends, invitations by link — everyone instantly sees what's missing.
land.f2d: Over 1,000 items, neatly sorted into categories — with filters for diets and world cuisines.
land.f3d: Put together recipes from your favorite ingredients, save them and share them with the community.
land.f4d: Keep an eye on deals, have your list read aloud and use it offline — even without signal in the store.
land.shotsSub: Clean lists, clear categories and recipes — on any phone.
land.installDesc: Get Shoppi on your phone — from the store or install it directly as a web app:
land.installIos: iPhone: In Safari, tap the Share icon and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
land.installAndroid: Android: In the browser menu, choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
land.recipesSub: Shared by the community — tap a recipe to see it in full.
land.genDesc: Choose the category you want. Get inspired and easily put together your dream recipe from your favorite ingredients. Here you can let your creativity run free. Your imagination knows almost no limits.
land.commDesc: Invite family and friends with a link — everyone sees the same list in real time. Save recipes privately or share them publicly with the world.
land.offersDesc: See at a glance which items are on offer — and plan your shopping smart.
land.faq1a: Shoppi is free. All features — lists, catalog, recipes and sharing — are free of charge.
land.faq2a: No, you can start right away. Signing in is worth it to save recipes and share them publicly.
land.faq3a: Yes. Your list is stored on your device and works without internet — changes sync later.
land.faq4a: German, English, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese and Dutch — with regional terms for 16 markets.
land.faq5q: How do I share lists and recipes?
land.faq5a: Lists: via an invitation link for family and friends. Recipes: choose “Public” when saving — the link opens the recipe directly.
land.contactDesc: Found a bug, have an idea for a new feature or a product is missing from the catalog? We'd love to hear from you.
land.nlDesc: Enter your email and hear about new features before anyone else.
land.nlErr: Please enter a valid email address.
land.news1d: New categories, more products and ongoing improvements — worth a look.
land.news2d: Share your favorite recipes with the community — publicly or privately.
land.news3d: We're working on more features. You'll find everything here soon.
